Non-article determiners (' this', ' my', ' her', ' some') and the connectives ' and', ' of', ' from', ' by' stay at 0-0.25 of max at any position, and short phrases built only of single-token particles (Up, down, In, out, On, off, Over, Back, forth, Through, Round, To, fro) joined by ' and' with no comma, article, noun or number are predicted inactive (near 0); adding a comma or 'the' + noun after such a chain makes it active.
